versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 of linkfox-dld-product-billboard

- Updated skill description to include trigger keywords in both Chinese and English within the same sentence for improved keyword matching.
- No code or functional changes detected; documentation update only.

- Initial release of the linkfox-dld-product-billboard skill.
- Enables querying 1688 platform bestseller and trending product rankings for sourcing and wholesale research.
- Supports both weekly and monthly billboard data with flexible parameter filtering (keywords, price, order count, supplier type, logistics, services).
- Provides usage examples and clear display rules including table formatting, image/link display, and keyword translation guidance.
- Documents important limitations on query parameters, data ranges, and result pagination.
